meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你的项目生成一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范文件,里面写明视觉氛围、带色值的配色、字体规则、组件状态、布局原则、动效参数和一份禁用清单,供 Google Stitch 生成界面时参照。
howto.when: 当你要用 Google Stitch 生成界面、需要一份可复用的设计规范文件时触发;前提是能访问 labs.google/stitch,也可选装 Stitch MCP Server 接入 Cursor、Gemini CLI 等。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目生成一份 DESIGN.md,风格偏画廊式留白。
say.note: 会按氛围、配色、字体等分节输出。

say.text: 把这份规范里的强调色改成低饱和度的橙色,只留一个。
say.note: 强调色限一个,饱和度低于 80%。

say.text: 这份 DESIGN.md 里不要出现 Inter 字体和纯黑 #000000。

howto.what_en: Generates a DESIGN.md spec for your project: visual atmosphere, color palette with hex codes, typography rules, component states, layout principles, motion parameters, and a banned-patterns list for Google Stitch.
howto.when_en: When you want to generate screens in Google Stitch and need a reusable design-spec file; requires access via labs.google/stitch, optionally the Stitch MCP Server for Cursor or Gemini CLI.

say_en.text: Write a DESIGN.md for this project with a gallery-airy feel.
say_en.note: Outputs sections for atmosphere, color, type, motion.

say_en.text: Change the single accent color to a low-saturation orange.
Keep Inter and pure black #000000 out of this DESIGN.md.
